definitions.explanation: A proposed plan for a project, event, or product, typically written up for review and approval. Compound of {企画|きかく} (planning) + {案|あん} (proposal, draft).

examples.japanese: {企画案|きかくあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{企画案|きかくあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I explained the new project proposal at the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{企画案|きかくあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The department head told me to rewrite the project proposal many times.

notes:
Common in business: a written proposal for an event, campaign, or new product that is presented for approval. The ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ suffix marks it as a draft idea still open to revision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {企画案|きかくあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧・⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a proposal
- {企画案|きかくあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練|ね}る→練る：09751_neru⟧: to work out / refine a proposal
- {企画案|きかくあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: a proposal is approved

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{改善案|かいぜんあん}→改善案：27964_kaizenan⟧: improvement proposal — focuses on fixing an existing situation
- ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧: proposal, suggestion — the general act of proposing
